system.description:
You manifest your Lightning release until you create a floating flower made of Lightning. This flower sparkles and sparks harmlessly for but a moment before it detonates.

Select a point you can within range for the flower to manifest. All creatures within 15 feet of the flower must make a Dexterity Saving throw.

On a failed saving throw they take 3d12 Lightning damage and are Blinded until end of their next turn.

On a successful save they gain 1 rank of the Shocked condition until the beginning of their next turn.

Overcharge. The affected creatures chooses to either make their saving throw with advantage or disadvantage with the following caveats;

Advantage. On a failure, they take 9d12 lightning damage and are Stunned until the end of their next turn.

Disadvantage. No additional effects.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d12.
